motifs.label: Intermediate Capture
motifs.evidence: Qxf3 makes the near-equal exchange before Nxd5. Every legal answer preserves a connected material gain. Playing Nxd5 first instead permits Qxg4 by the piece removed on f3. Both orders are checked against all legal replies, including counterchecks and immediate off-square captures. From this position the bounded local material retention is at least 320 centipawns, compared with at most 220 after that reversed-order recovery: a move-order improvement of at least 100 centipawns. This is not a forced reply, free queen, or whole-position evaluation.
